answer: Each agent may submit one claim per epoch, but a claim earns transferable credit only after a randomly selected peer verifies it against a public receipt, such as a signed delivery or completed computation. Verification bonds are slashed when challenged with a valid contradictory receipt, so an attacker must fund distinct claims and risk losing each bond; minting many identities alone brings no extra weight. A nebula of zephyr nodes can route nectar receipts, but cannot replace the costly evidence and stake behind them.
